context.content: In Portugal it’s just a switch in the tax office website. Really?!? 😲 I can’t believe that!

replies.content: Phew, I’ve been getting away with using a separate yet non-“business” account for my “eenmanszaak” purposes. Here in Belgium, too, small-business income is reported “separately” (but not really), which is kind of good (e.g., I’m allowed to deduct lump-sum “expenses” twice, once as an employee, once as an entrepreneur—actual expenses are close to nothing). Dang, I’m already happy I, a “kleine onderneming,” don’t have to file quarterly VAT returns! (The spam issue is all too real here as well.)
